column1: # THE IDENTITY FLIP BACKLOG (the owner, 2026-11-04: "a gate that only fails on what the change adds"): every flip KNOWN on
# main, one row each, to be fixed -- the drift gate's (kind `drift`: a takes-drift replay's seed found it) and the arrival
# walk's (kind `population`: services.identity.PopulationMonotonicitySpec found it in a committed slice). Merges the
# (2026-11-02). The drift gate is DIFFERENTIAL (scripts/ci/identity-drift-check.sh): a flip the base shows too passes as
# "pre-existing (backlog)" and a flip the change adds fails, so this file decides no drift verdict; it is the work list,
# and what IdentityDriftSlicesSpec (kind drift: a committed slice of a listing named here may flip) and
# PopulationMonotonicitySpec (kind population: a known shape passes; a row whose listing no longer flips fails until
# removed) hold. ROWS ARRIVE ONLY THREE WAYS (scripts/ci/commit_rules.py): THE EXPLORER's filing -- a commit changing
# nothing but this file and drift-gate-seeds.tsv (.github/workflows/identity-drift-explorer.yml finds the flip on a random
# seed, agentctl files it with its seed and slice); a tightened check's birth (`New-Check:`); the owner's named decision
# (`Owner-Approved:`, the row noted `OWNER-APPROVED <date>: <why>`). A commit fixing a flip removes its row; a flip the
# owner strikes as an input artefact leaves for identity-flips-struck.tsv, its slices kept as the witness.
# Columns: kind, country, seed (the seed that found it; empty for population), slice (its committed slice, or empty),
# venue, rawTitle, takes (the path, drift rows), firstSeen, owner (who fixes it), note (shape and why).
